rules.difficult: VOC difficult objects are iscrowd = 1 in COCO (ignore region in COCOeval) and are not part of YOLO training labels
rules.out_of_ontology: objects of the other 16 VOC classes are not annotated; images with only such objects are negatives
rules.truncated_occluded: kept as ordinary objects, as in VOC; see the VOC annotation guidelines

roles.manual_train: labelled, used for training both students
roles.gold_val: labelled, used for all threshold, prompt and policy choices
roles.pool: unlabelled for students; teacher keeps the VOC annotation for audit only
roles.gold_test: labelled, opened once at the end of step 7
